findings.title: Nil customer not handled in total_due
findings.explanation: Invoices without a customer raise NoMethodError when total_due is called.

findings.title: Sort column is not checked against SORTABLE
findings.explanation: Any column name is accepted, so an unknown column raises at query time.
findings.suggested_fix: Fall back to created_at unless SORTABLE includes the param.

findings.title: Invoice counts as overdue on its due date
findings.explanation: Changing < to <= marks invoices overdue on the day they are due.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep < unless the PR means to change this.
